understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked +; all goals had to be occupied simultaneously for the level and game to report WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved one grid cell per directional action, while walls or boundaries could block movement. Adjacent pushable blocks could be shifted by moving into them, and CLICK selected a piece at its exact pixel/grid coordinate. Movement-blocked hints were not always definitive, but repeated clicks on an already selected or inaccessible position consumed steps without changing control.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked +; all goals had to be occupied simultaneously for the level and game to report WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved one grid cell per directional action, while walls or boundaries could block movement. Adjacent pushable blocks could be shifted by moving into them, and CLICK selected a piece at its exact pixel/grid coordinate. Movement-blocked hints were not always definitive, but repeated clicks on an already selected or inaccessible position consumed steps without changing control.
